title: Aureline M5 delegated-credential row component
description: Names which identity is acting — local, forwarded, delegated-on-behalf, impersonation-scoped, service account, or revoked delegation — and the credential class behind it, so a user never has to infer whether the identity being forwarded or delegated is their own. Canonical per-component contract frozen by the M5 credential component matrix (schemas/ui/m5-credential-component-matrix.schema.json); downstream M5 rows point at this schema instead of restating credential UI truth by hand. Raw secret values, tokens, passphrases, and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
